description:
The Display Provider maintains one subscription per S2 cell at a specified level for each cell covering an area that was queried by an observer.

monitoring.benchmarker.configurations.users.S2GriddedSubscriptionStrategySpecification, as defined in monitoring/benchmarker/configurations/users.py

$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

delete_after_unused.description: If specified, a subscription is deleted when no observer query has covered its cell for this amount of time.  Otherwise, subscriptions are left to expire.

extension_duration.description: Amount of time by which the end of a subscription is pushed back when it is extended.

extension_window.description: When an observer query covers a cell whose subscription expires in less than this amount of time, the subscription is extended.

initial_duration.description: When an observer query covers a cell without an unexpired subscription, a subscription is created for that cell with this duration.

max_alt.description: Altitude above which subscriptions do not apply.

min_alt.description: Altitude below which subscriptions do not apply.

s2_level.description: The S2 level at which subscriptions are established and maintained.
